# tau-voice retail task 98

A customer-service phone call: a simulated caller (tau2's user simulator,
voiced) calls the agent under test, which answers by voice and uses the
domain's tools. Graded by tau2's evaluator.

This task is run by harbor-voice's call runner
(`harbor_voice.harbor_agent:VoiceCallAgent`), which reads the spec below.

```toml
# Generated by tau_voice.main from tau2-bench@2174a60.
task = "tau-voice/retail/98"
seed = 626729

[call]
driver = "tau_voice.trial:drive"
timeout_sec = 10800

[call.config]
domain = "retail"
task_id = "98"
speech_complexity = "control"
seed = 626729
hallucination_retries = 3

[environment]
docker_image = "ghcr.io/amoh-ai/tau-voice-main:c168c1f67a@sha256:1ef3961c8f730e03b044c974a6a0fb4c6c34d972f02c302e24361c8d92292049"
build_timeout_sec = 1800
cpus = 2
memory_mb = 4096
storage_mb = 10240
env = { OPENAI_API_KEY = "${OPENAI_API_KEY}", ELEVENLABS_API_KEY = "${ELEVENLABS_API_KEY}", AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID = "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}", AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY = "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}", AWS_REGION = "${AWS_REGION}", TAU2_VOICE_ID_MATT_DELANEY = "${TAU2_VOICE_ID_MATT_DELANEY}", TAU2_VOICE_ID_LISA_BRENNER = "${TAU2_VOICE_ID_LISA_BRENNER}", TAU2_VOICE_ID_MILDRED_KAPLAN = "${TAU2_VOICE_ID_MILDRED_KAPLAN}", TAU2_VOICE_ID_ARJUN_ROY = "${TAU2_VOICE_ID_ARJUN_ROY}", TAU2_VOICE_ID_WEI_LIN = "${TAU2_VOICE_ID_WEI_LIN}", TAU2_VOICE_ID_MAMADOU_DIALLO = "${TAU2_VOICE_ID_MAMADOU_DIALLO}", TAU2_VOICE_ID_PRIYA_PATIL = "${TAU2_VOICE_ID_PRIYA_PATIL}", TAU_VOICE_REVIEW_MODEL = "${TAU_VOICE_REVIEW_MODEL:-bedrock/us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-5-20251101-v1:0}", HARBOR_VOICE_TTS_CACHE = "/cache/tts" }

[verifier]
timeout_sec = 900
```
